purpose: Configuration and separation policy for the MORNING graded-DCA stream, which has ONE mode: the 10:30 AM ET live Robinhood execution (mode='live', run_type='morning_dca_live', trades=true) using a true 60-minute intraday trend window. (The 9:45 AM ET read-only watchlist scan was retired on 2026-10-14; historical scan artifacts remain readable via the run-classification schema.) The stream shares the $2-base 0x-to-8x live ladder and the morning budget ledger, and is INDEPENDENT of, and never valid evidence for, the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b).
confidence_rule: In LIVE mode, a candidate whose price/drop passes the ladder is auto-bought ONLY when the intraday trend can be validated (>= trend_min_bars usable intraday bars at or before the decision time). If price/drop passes but the intraday trend cannot be validated, the run must NOT auto-buy; it classifies the candidate as execution_status='manual_review_candidate'. There is no loosened trend-unavailable execution path.
live_execution_enabled_note: SHIPS ENABLED. The 10:30 AM ET morning live stream (42173154) is one of the canonical live executions, authorized for live broker placement.

live_task.name: Weekday 10:30 AM morning DCA live Robinhood execution
live_task.cron_utc_note: 14:30 UTC weekdays; ET equivalent 10:30 AM during US Eastern Daylight Time (EDT, UTC-4).
live_task.note: Live Robinhood execution using account <ROBINHOOD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER> as the sole execution broker (Alpaca/Finance stay read-only for validation/context). Uses a true 60-minute intraday trend window (moved from the former 9:45 AM live slot). PRE-AUTHORIZED direct placement (user approved 2026-07-10 11:20 AM ET): for scheduled live runs only it MUST NOT request per-order confirmation and MUST NOT call Robinhood review_equity_order; it calls place_equity_order directly ONLY after every safeguard (signal, budget, spread, data confidence, trend validation, top-up, circuit breakers) passes. Manual/ad hoc runs still go through Robinhood's review + confirmation path: review_equity_order (review_market_buy) must pass before place_equity_order (place_market_buy) is attempted; if Robinhood's own review requires additional post-review confirmation (e.g. a step-up/2FA gate), placement raises OrderConfirmationRequiredError and the run records not_submitted_confirmation_required with no order placed -- there is no separate confirmation step implemented in this code beyond that broker-driven gate. Every configured, non-excluded ticker is evaluated (nothing narrows the universe first); it recomputes a FRESH price, prior close, spread, 60-minute downtrend, signal, and budget before placing; if the trend cannot be validated it does NOT auto-buy (skip / manual_review_candidate). Subject to the confidence_rule and to the GFUZ special handling (see gfuz_special_handling), the raw-data persistence contract (see raw_data_persistence), and the automatic failure recovery contract (see automatic_failure_recovery). MORNING BUDGET LEDGER (see budget_ledger.bootstrap): the morning stream budget ledger lives under /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/morning_dca/YYYYMMDD_1030ET/; the task may create budget_ledger.json there if absent, must not require a pre-existing ledger file, and if none exists initializes from the configured morning daily/weekly caps and writes the calculations into the 10:30 run_state.json. Neither fix weakens the budget caps, top-up guard, data-confidence rule, spread rule, whitelist, buy-only, regular-hours-only, Robinhood-execution-only, or any other safety control.

gfuz_special_handling.reason: Robinhood is the primary quote/prior-close source for GFUZ because Finance (and other read-only providers) may not resolve it. Alpaca/Finance remain read-only validation/context only.

raw_data_persistence.reason: RAW DATA PERSISTENCE FIX (added Jul 15 2026, confirmed Jul 16 2026): before any signal computation, budget calculation, top-up calculation, or order placement, the 10:30 live task must persist every raw connector response used by the run so the decision engine reads only from persisted files (mirrors the afternoon 10ce362c fix).
rules: Before any signal computation, budget calculation, top-up calculation, or order placement, persist every raw Robinhood/Finance/Alpaca connector response used by the run under morning_dca/YYYYMMDD_1030ET/raw/ using deterministic filenames.
Normalize large connector output_path / wrapped outputs into parseable JSON before persisting (referenced contents under 'data', original pointer preserved under 'output_path').
The decision engine must read ONLY from the persisted files under raw/, never from in-memory tool responses. Order of operations: fetch -> persist -> normalize -> compute -> place.
If data fetch succeeds but raw persistence or normalization fails, do NOT place orders; still write run_state.json with the blocking reason (raw_persistence_error) and no orders placed.
raw_data_persistence.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED in MorningDCAExecutor (morning_dca.py) as of 2026-07-21, closing the P1 flagged by Codex review on PR #78 ('Implement v2 persistence before emitting v2 artifacts') and the follow-up P1 on PR #144 ('Implement the morning raw-input and failure-state path'). For a SCHEDULED (non-manual) live run in MORNING_LIVE_MODE, run() wraps the injected data provider and broker adapter in _PersistingMarketDataProvider / _PersistingBrokerAdapter (backed by _RawInputRecorder), which persist every previous-close/intraday-bar/quote/bid-ask response and every account-number/buying-power/tradability/same-day-order-existence broker query under raw/ via scripts.run_classification.save_raw_input the moment each is obtained -- before evaluate_signal or _place_broker_orders computes from it. This differs from the afternoon run_dca.py pattern in ONE respect: morning fetches lazily per ticker rather than as one upfront batch, so persistence happens per-call rather than as a single preceding step; functionally equivalent, since nothing is used to compute a signal or place an order before its own response is durably recorded, but there is no staging-dir/atomic-swap/backup machinery like run_pipeline()'s raw.tmp/raw.bak (not needed at the same-file granularity this design uses). A persistence failure discovered during evaluate() (before any broker call) fails the run closed via _blocked_live_result() with error_class='missing_or_invalid_raw_inputs' and zero orders placed; a persistence failure discovered only after order placement has begun is NOT retroactively blocking (the orders already placed passed every existing safeguard) and is instead surfaced via raw_persistence_error on the final run_state. Applies identically to the 12:30 midday live task: MiddayDCAExecutor inherits run() unchanged. Covered by test_morning_dca.py (raw-input persistence section) and test_midday_dca.py::test_midday_scheduled_live_run_persists_raw_inputs. automatic_failure_recovery (bounded retry / recovery_rerun) below is a distinct, still-unimplemented policy -- this fix fails closed on a persistence failure rather than auto-retrying it.
raw_data_persistence.state_schema_version_caveat: state_schema_version='morning-live-v2-preauthorized' is written on every scheduled 10:30 run; as of 2026-07-21 raw_data_persistence is implemented (see implementation_status above) while automatic_failure_recovery below is not, so the version tag's 'preauthorized' contract is now backed by real persistence but not yet by automatic bounded-retry recovery.

automatic_failure_recovery.summary: If the 10:30 live run fails because of internal persistence, parsing, wrapper-normalization, transient connector throttling, or a raw-file write problem AFTER data was fetched, it immediately reruns the required read-only inputs once, persists all raw responses first, recomputes only from persisted files, and continues the same guarded execution if safeguards pass.
rules: Trigger only on recoverable internal failures after data was fetched: persistence, parsing, wrapper-normalization, transient connector throttling, or raw-file write problems.
Rerun required read-only inputs exactly once; persist all raw responses first; recompute only from the persisted files; continue the same guarded execution if all safeguards pass.
Reuse the SAME logical run directory (morning_dca/YYYYMMDD_1030ET/) with recovery_rerun=true; never classify a recovery rerun as manual (run_origin stays 'scheduled', manual_run stays false).
If the recovery rerun also fails, or a safety/account/order rejection occurs, write run_state.json with the blocking reason and escalate.
automatic_failure_recovery.implementation_status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in MorningDCAExecutor (morning_dca.py) as of 2026-07-18, same Codex finding as raw_data_persistence.implementation_status above -- there is no recovery-rerun code path in morning_dca.py's run(), so recovery_rerun/recovery_reason/recovery_attempts are never populated on any morning artifact.

manual_missed_run_recovery.summary: When the scheduled 10:30 AM live morning task did not run (missed scheduled fire), a human-triggered manual recovery may place the missed morning buys by hand. These MANUAL missed-morning recovery artifacts are written under a dedicated manual_recovery/ path and are prior-allocation / same-day top-up context ONLY. They are NEVER proof that the 10:30 scheduled task ran and NEVER scheduled evidence.
manual_missed_run_recovery.example_note: Jul 20 2026 manual missed-morning recovery: the 10:30 scheduled morning live task did not run, so a manual recovery ran at 10:48 AM ET and wrote artifacts under manual_recovery/20260720_1048ET.
rules: Valid as prior-allocation / same-day top-up context ONLY when run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, and valid_scheduled_evidence=false all hold.
MUST NEVER count as proof that the 10:30 scheduled task ran.
MUST NEVER be written into the midday or afternoon scheduled evidence stream.
MUST NEVER be used for scheduled reliability, scheduled fill counts, scheduled slippage, scheduled cost basis, or watchdog confirmation.
MAY ONLY reduce or block additional buys through the same-day top-up rule: a later run buys max(0, desired - prior) and only if the later decision price is strictly below the prior reference price.
The 12:30 midday run and the 3:20 final run MUST scan manual_recovery/YYYYMMDD_* for same-day manual recovery artifacts and fold them into the top-up guard as prior allocation.

live_schedule_hardening_2026_07_20.trigger_incident: On Jul 20 2026 the 10:30 scheduled morning live run failed: it invoked a saved runner without first generating the same-day raw inputs and escalated without persisting a scheduled failure-state artifact.

raw_input_generation.summary: The 10:30 scheduled live morning task MUST NOT assume runner inputs already exist. Before invoking any saved runner or order module, it MUST create the raw directory and persist all required raw inputs for the current same-day run.
required_inputs: historical / trend bars needed for the 60-minute trend check
raw_input_generation.run_date_arg: If a runner requires a RUN_DATE_ET argument, pass the current America/New_York date as YYYYMMDD.
raw_input_generation.no_stale_reuse: Do NOT reuse stale files from a prior run.
raw_input_generation.data_sources: Finance connector primary, Alpaca and Robinhood validation/context, no fallback source.
raw_input_generation.bounded_recovery: If raw input generation fails once, perform ONE bounded recovery attempt with the alternate approved data source path, then stop.
raw_input_generation.implementation_status: raw-input PERSISTENCE is IMPLEMENTED as of 2026-07-21 -- see raw_data_persistence.implementation_status above for the mechanism (MorningDCAExecutor.run() wraps the injected data provider/broker in persisting decorators for every scheduled live run; inherited by the 12:30 midday task). quotes/prior-close/historical-bars/tradability/buying-power/orders_since_midnight are all covered by what this codebase's MarketDataProvider/BrokerAdapter protocols actually expose (there is no separate 'portfolio' query beyond available_buying_power() in this repo's BrokerAdapter). bounded_recovery (retry once against the alternate data source on failure) is NOT implemented -- a persistence failure fails the run closed (or, once placement has begun, is recorded non-fatally) rather than auto-retrying; this matches automatic_failure_recovery.implementation_status below, which remains unimplemented.

blocked_state.when: If missing/invalid raw inputs, trend, budget, tradability, spread, or broker condition blocks execution, write a valid scheduled morning run_state.
blocked_state.block_reason: Concrete, human-readable reason (e.g. 'raw input persistence failed: <detail>').
blocked_state.field_names_note: Updated 2026-07-27, superseding the 2026-07-21 correction: morning run_state files DO now carry order_submit_status. A live run sets it on every outcome -- 'submitted' when at least one order landed, 'no_orders_submitted' on a completed no-order run, 'not_submitted_confirmation_required' or 'not_submitted_error' when the placement path produced a concrete terminal status, and 'not_submitted_error' on a blocked-before-placement or startup failure. status/block_reason/error_class are still written alongside it, and the run also carries run_classification_outcome, completion_reason, is_trading_failure, orders_submitted_count, and the spread-gate counts. The earlier note recorded pre-contract behavior. See config/scheduled_tasks.json:scheduled_run_artifact_contract.root_level_artifact_set_2026_07_27.

live_schedule_hardening_2026_07_20.evidence_meaning: This failure-state artifact is valid proof that the 10:30 scheduled task FIRED, but it is NOT order or fill evidence.
live_schedule_hardening_2026_07_20.no_silent_escalation: Do NOT escalate without writing this state file unless the workspace itself is unavailable.
live_schedule_hardening_2026_07_20.post_raw_failure_rule: If failure happens after raw collection has started, write the COMPLETE root-level artifact set: run_state.json, run_summary.json, morning_signals.csv (header row even when no signal could be computed), and submitted_orders.csv with its canonical header even at zero orders. Do not leave a half-done run with a state file and nothing else, and never write any of them only under a nested subfolder. The failure state carries run_classification_outcome='failed_scheduled_run_startup' (or 'failed_after_partial_submission' when an order had already been submitted), order_submit_status, is_trading_failure=true, orders_submitted_count, and scheduled_evidence_denied=true so no consumer counts it as scheduled evidence. Any order that WAS already placed is preserved in broker_outcomes and buy_candidates, never overwritten with a zero-order record.

artifacts.manifest_accuracy_note: Updated 2026-07-27 to match MorningDCAExecutor.write_artifacts() after the root-level artifact contract landed, superseding the 2026-07-18 / 2026-07-19 / 2026-07-20 notes that recorded pre-contract behavior. A scheduled 10:30 LIVE run ALWAYS writes the complete ROOT-LEVEL set: run_state.json, run_summary.json, morning_signals.csv (the stream-specific signals name), and submitted_orders.csv with its canonical header even at zero orders. It also always writes budget_ledger.json (filename from budget_ledger.ledger_files), a snapshot of artifacts.budget, bootstrapped from the configured caps when no prior ledger file exists. run_summary.json was previously not written for live runs and submitted_orders.csv was previously conditional on at least one submitted order; both are now unconditional for live runs, so a no-order run is a well-formed artifact rather than a contract failure. filled_orders.csv is never written by this task: morning_dca.py has no fill-confirmation step, and that filename appears under a morning run directory only via a separate manual-override process (see near_close_dca.py / scripts/run_classification.py). See config/scheduled_tasks.json:scheduled_run_artifact_contract.root_level_artifact_set_2026_07_27.

sizing_ladder.name: live_0x_to_5x
sizing_ladder.tier_boundary_rule: min inclusive, max exclusive; the largest tier threshold <= actual drop wins; drop < 0.1% = 0x (no buy).
sizing_ladder.separation_note: As of the Fri Jul 10 2026 live-automation update the morning live stream uses the SAME shared $2-base 0x-to-8x ladder as the midday and afternoon streams (config/sizing_ladder.json). The former morning-only 0x-to-3x ladder (0.1-2/2-5/5-8/8+ -> 1x/1.5x/2x/3x) is HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED. Max per order is therefore 8x * $2 = $16.

budget_ledger.shared_pool_note: POOLING FIX (Geoff, confirmed 2026-08-02: 'caps aren't pooled the way the target design intends -- fix it'). Raised from the old isolated per-stream half-share (90.0/450.0) to the SAME shared Normal-tier ceiling every stream draws from (near_close_dca.BUDGET_TIERS[0], mirrored in config/budgets.json and config/midday_dca.json), and cap_seed_roots below now spans every sibling stream so this ledger actually sees what the whole day/week has spent, not just its own history. This does not implement the afternoon stream's dynamic Elevated/High-volatility/Stress escalation for the morning slot itself -- a broad-selloff day still only escalates the shared ceiling from the 3:30 final run's fuller-day view (which already subtracts morning/midday/market-open/intraday spend before applying its own selected tier). Morning (and every other pre-final stream) conservatively shares the flat Normal $180/day, $900/week floor; it never independently escalates past it. This is a deliberately conservative simplification, not full tier parity -- earlier streams can only ever be MORE restrictive than the true escalated-day ceiling, never less.

bootstrap.reason: MORNING BUDGET LEDGER LOCATION FIX (added Jul 20 2026): the 10:30 AM morning live run escalated on Jul 20 2026 partly because it was unsure where the morning budget ledger lived and whether a pre-existing ledger file was required. The morning stream budget ledger lives under the morning live output directory /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/morning_dca/YYYYMMDD_1030ET/, NOT under the afternoon ce16ba6b tree, or a /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/42173154 path.
rules: The morning stream budget ledger is under /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/morning_dca/YYYYMMDD_1030ET/. The task MAY create budget_ledger.json there if it is absent.
Do NOT require a pre-existing ledger file. If none exists, initialize the morning ledger from the configured morning_daily_cap_usd and morning_weekly_cap_usd caps.
After initializing, write the resulting budget calculations (caps, same-day morning spend, remaining daily/weekly capacity) into the 10:30 run_state.json under morning_dca/YYYYMMDD_1030ET/.
A missing ledger file is NOT an escalation condition; it is bootstrapped from the configured caps.
bootstrap.safety_note: Bootstrapping an absent ledger from the configured caps does not weaken any cap. The morning_daily_cap_usd / morning_weekly_cap_usd caps, the top-up guard, and all circuit breakers still apply exactly as before; only the requirement of a pre-existing file on disk is removed.
bootstrap.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED in morning_dca.py as of 2026-07-21 (see load_morning_config() and MorningDCAExecutor.write_artifacts()): ledger_files[0] is loaded into MorningConfig.budget_ledger_filename, and write_artifacts() always writes that file (budget_ledger.json) under the run's own output directory as a snapshot of artifacts.budget -- the same caps/spend/remaining-capacity object already written into run_state.json -- for every live run, bootstrapping it from the configured caps whenever no prior file exists rather than requiring one.

budget_ledger.separation_note: Superseded 2026-08-02 by shared_pool_note above: the morning ledger's CAP is now the same shared $180/day, $900/week Normal-tier ceiling every stream draws from (not an isolated 90/450 half-share), and cap_seed_roots spans every sibling stream so it is genuinely pooled. It remains a separate LEDGER OBJECT from the afternoon StrategyState / BUDGET_TIERS ledger (different code path, different persisted file) -- morning buys are still recorded and reported under their own namespace -- but the CEILING they're checked against is shared, not independent.

artifact_paths.manual_recovery_note: manual_recovery/YYYYMMDD_* holds MANUAL missed-morning 10:30 recovery artifacts (run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, valid_scheduled_evidence=false). See manual_missed_run_recovery. They are same-day prior-allocation / top-up context only for the later midday (12:30) and afternoon (3:20) runs; they are never scheduled evidence and never prove the 10:30 scheduled task ran.
artifact_paths.separation_note: The morning stream writes ONLY under its own root. None writes into /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/**, updates latest_scheduled_run.json, or touches afternoon scheduled_runs/ folders. The legacy 'morning_run_state_root' key mirrors the live root for backwards compatibility. prior_allocation_roots lists all roots scanned for earlier same-day manual fills so the morning live run applies the per-ticker top-up offset guard. cap_seed_roots (widened 2026-08-02, see budget_ledger.shared_pool_note) now covers every sibling stream's root -- morning_dca itself (so a restart or scheduler retry still seeds from any prior morning fill), market_open_dca, midday_dca, intraday_dca, ce16ba6b, and final_manual_review (the out-of-tree manual final-buy override root, e.g. budget_block_override_YYYYMMDD_HHMMET fills after a scheduled run budget-blocked signals) -- so this ledger's shared $180/$900 ceiling reflects the whole day's/week's cross-stream spend, not just morning's own. It used to deliberately exclude the afternoon root so afternoon recovery fills could not exhaust an isolated morning-only cap; now that the cap itself is the shared ceiling, seeing afternoon (and every other stream's) spend here is the correct, intended behavior, not a risk to guard against.

top_up_guard.purpose: Morning live orders/fills are recorded as prior same-day allocation context so the afternoon 3:20 task can offset (top up) rather than duplicate the same-day position. This is the ONLY way morning activity feeds the afternoon stream.
top_up_guard.price_rule: When earlier same-day buys exist for a ticker, the afternoon task only buys if the current price is strictly below the prior-run reference price; otherwise it holds.
top_up_guard.note: These are the actual fields emitted per buy_candidate in buy_candidates rows by near_close_dca.run_once when the top-up guard is active; morning fills populate prior_same_day_* for the afternoon evaluation.

downstream_separation_rules: Afternoon consumers glob only /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/scheduled_runs/** and therefore never traverse either morning root.
A morning run_state has stream='morning' and valid_afternoon_evidence=false; any consumer must exclude it from afternoon scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, and order-count metrics.
Neither morning mode updates latest_scheduled_run.json or writes into afternoon scheduled/manual folders.

Morning fills (live) count only as PRIOR-ALLOCATION CONTEXT for the afternoon same-day top-up guard; they are never afternoon scheduled evidence, slippage, watchdog confirmation, scheduled cost basis, or scheduled fill counts.
